episodes.synopsis: Butt Detective and Brown head to a ski slope to investigate rumors of a monstrous yeti, who is behind the resort’s sudden drop in customers.

episodes.synopsis: Chief Maltese butts heads with his rival, Chief Chihuahua, at a restaurant. After something goes missing, they compete to see who can solve the case.

episodes.synopsis: Butt Detective uses tricky tactics to give Brown a lesson in sleuthing. Later, the local kids surprise Brown by giving him a case of his own to solve.

episodes.synopsis: Butt Detective and Brown receive a mysterious visitor. Once they deduce his identity, he asks them to help stop Kaito U from stealing his treasure.

episodes.synopsis: Butt Detective and the contestants face their next trial: a giant, menacing snake. Later, Kaito U finally shows himself and tries to steal the veil.

episodes.synopsis: Kaito U enters the infamously inescapable Orinona Prison and its straight-arrow warden vows to reform him. But Kaito U isn't about to change his ways.
episodes.title: Episode 47

episodes.synopsis: Kaito U and his crow companion escape from their prison cell, but they're not out of danger yet. Their first stop is the guards' break room.
episodes.title: Episode 48

episodes.synopsis: While Butt Detective and the canine cops review a string of apple thefts, a journalist bursts in to report his camera was stolen by a spooky culprit.
episodes.title: Episode 49

episodes.synopsis: After two painful cavities lead Brown and Koala-chan to meet at the dentist's office, a canine detective asks them to find his 11 missing puppies.
episodes.title: Episode 50

episodes.synopsis: The canine cops reveal a new crime-fighting invention that they're very proud of. But it reminds Brown of the destruction caused by their last one.

episodes.synopsis: Kaito U is going after the opera house's treasure, so Butt Detective and Brown pay a visit. One of the actors they see on stage is awfully familiar.
